IEEE PETER CHEN NOTATION CONVENTIONS & CARDINALITY MAPPING: ▪ Single Rectangle = Strong Entity Set | Double Rectangle = Weak Entity Set | Diamond = Relationship Set | Double Diamond = Identifying Relationship ▪ Oval = Attribute | Underlined = Primary Key (PK) | Dashed Underline = Partial Key | Double Oval = Multi-valued (M) | Dashed Oval = Derived (D) ▪ Cardinality: Directed Arrow (→) strictly denotes 1-side cardinality; Blunt Straight Line (—) strictly denotes Many-side (N / M) cardinality (No numeric labels used).
